policy_title: Social Tariff for Vulnerable Households' Energy Bills
stated: Introduce a social tariff for the most vulnerable to provide targeted energy discounts for vulnerable households.

source.quote: Introducing a social tariff for the most vulnerable to provide targeted energy discounts for vulnerable households.

bearing_set.reason: A targeted energy discount directly reduces energy bills for vulnerable households, materially affecting cost of living for those least able to afford it.

By design the discount is concentrated on lower-income/vulnerable households, whose energy costs are a much higher share of income; this materially narrows the energy-cost element of the income gap, moving the O14 inequality indicator.

membership_note: The policy bears clearly on cost-of-living (O2) as its primary target and on inequality (O14) via its distributional incidence. Funding mechanism is unstated so a public-finances (O12) bearing cannot be mechanistically pinned without further specification.
